snippet.title: Dwarven Digging Machine Demo release trailer.
snippet.description:
Steam demo for Dwarven Digging Machine is now available!

Build a huge mining drill in this incremental strategy base builder. Manage dwarves, rooms and mechanisms to get as deep as you can.
